label: Worldview consistency
term: worldview consistency (internal versus with an external objective duty)
resolution: Internal consistency means satisfiability of the worldview alone (DEF-WORLDVIEW-SEMANTIC-CONSISTENCY). Consistency *with* an objective duty means satisfiability of the worldview jointly with a particular duty-content (DEF-WORLDVIEW-DUTY-COMPATIBILITY). The internal-contradiction theorem additionally assumes the worldview explicitly accepts that duty; the external-error theorem instead assumes the duty-content is true at the designated actual world. The finite denier model shows these conditions cannot be silently identified.
